programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.title: La misericordia y el perdón
programme.desc: Cristo es la Cabeza de la Iglesia y todos sus miembros forman parte de ese Cuerpo Místico. Una bella reflexión de cómo ser Iglesia.

programme.title: Tertulias de fe
programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. Además de su labor en las parroquias, ayudó a fundar en 2011 el capítulo en español del movimiento católico Magnificat con la aprobación del obispo de la región.

programme.title: Siervo de todos
programme.desc: En un tiempo en el que la voz del Señor parece ahogada por «otras voces» y la propuesta de seguirlo entregando la propia vida puede parecer un absurdo, Dios sigue llamando a quien quiere, otorgando a través del Sacramento del Orden, la misión de servir en nombre y representación de Cristo-Cabeza en medio de la comunidad. A toda la Iglesia le urge responder a esta llamada.

programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. Además responde a las preguntas llegadas al programa vía telefónica, el correo electrónico (padrepedro@ewtn.com) y Facebook (www.facebook.com/ppedronunez).

programme.title: Perspectiva Católica
programme.desc: En una época en la que la bandera de la libertad parece flamear casi en todas partes, se dan cada vez más y más atropellos en contra de la libertad de vivencia y profesión de la fe. Magdalena Lira, directora nacional de ACN (Ayuda a la Iglesia que sufre) en Chile, nos ofrece un panorama de la situación en el país, que se encuentra en observación en materia de libertad religiosa.

programme.title: Informe provida
programme.sub-title: Cuando la desesperación tiene una salida
programme.desc: En este programa nos uniremos en oración por la defensa de la vida, inspirados en el legado del Beato Fulton J. Sheen y su profunda devoción a la Hora Santa. A través de la adoración eucarística y la oración por los niños por nacer, reflexionaremos sobre la importancia de interceder por quienes se encuentran en peligro de aborto, confiando en el poder de la oración y en la misericordia de Dios.

programme.desc: De acuerdo con la doctrina de la fe católica, el purgatorio es el estado de purificación final antes de gozar de la presencia de Jesús y estar junto para siempre. La madre Angélica, mediante ejemplos explica lo que es el purgatorio y porque existe.

programme.title: Informe provida
programme.sub-title: Cuando la desesperación tiene una salida
programme.desc: En este programa nos uniremos en oración por la defensa de la vida, inspirados en el legado del Beato Fulton J. Sheen y su profunda devoción a la Hora Santa. A través de la adoración eucarística y la oración por los niños por nacer, reflexionaremos sobre la importancia de interceder por quienes se encuentran en peligro de aborto, confiando en el poder de la oración y en la misericordia de Dios.

programme.title: Beato Anacleto González
programme.desc: Con el recrudecimiento de la persecución religiosa Anacleto González pasó a la clandestinidad por ser blanco del gobierno, pero fue aprisionado, torturado y ejecutado. Sus últimas palabras: “Yo muero, pero Dios no muere. ¡Viva Cristo Rey!”

programme.title: Perspectiva Católica
programme.desc: En una época en la que la bandera de la libertad parece flamear casi en todas partes, se dan cada vez más y más atropellos en contra de la libertad de vivencia y profesión de la fe. Magdalena Lira, directora nacional de ACN (Ayuda a la Iglesia que sufre) en Chile, nos ofrece un panorama de la situación en el país, que se encuentra en observación en materia de libertad religiosa.

programme.desc: Este documental cuenta la historia del primer santo argentino Héctor Valdivielso Sáez quien hizo parte de los ocho católicos mártires de la llamada Revolución de Asturias. El y sus compañeros fueron fusilados sin acusación ni juicio previo.

programme.title: Donde Dios llora
programme.sub-title: Los inicios de la nueva evangelización en Corea
programme.desc: Con más de 49 años de sacerdocio, el Padre Santiago ha sido testigo de cómo la fe transforma vidas, incluso en medio de las dificultades más extremas. Nos habla de su llegada a Corea, de las vivencias de los coreanos en su camino de fe, y de cómo el amor y la generosidad se manifiestan en la vida diaria, a pesar de las temperaturas extremas y las dificultades del idioma.

programme.title: Mujeres en la Biblia
programme.desc: Jesús recorría ciudades y pueblos predicando y anunciando el reino de dios. Lo acompañaban los 12, y algunas mujeres que habían sido sanadas de malos espíritus y enfermedades. Eran maría magdalena, Juana, y Susana.

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.title: Tertulias de fe
programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. Además de su labor en las parroquias, ayudó a fundar en 2011 el capítulo en español del movimiento católico Magnificat con la aprobación del obispo de la región.

programme.title: Cocina franciscana
programme.desc: Hoy usamos una hortaliza poco conocida en España, el sayote. Con ella elaboramos un tartar de sayote con salmón. Aprovechamos este vídeo para hablar de la festividad de la Vírgen de la Inmaculada y de Duns Scoto, un humilde fraile franciscano que defendió la Inmaculada Concepción hasta hacerla Dogma de la Iglesia Católica.

programme.title: Santo Rosario
programme.desc: En los Misterios Gloriosos meditamos sobre la vida de Jesús desde la Resurrección del Señor hasta la Coronación de la Santísima Virgen María.

programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. Además responde a las preguntas llegadas al programa vía telefónica, el correo electrónico (padrepedro@ewtn.com) y Facebook (www.facebook.com/ppedronunez).

programme.title: Perspectiva Católica
programme.desc: En una época en la que la bandera de la libertad parece flamear casi en todas partes, se dan cada vez más y más atropellos en contra de la libertad de vivencia y profesión de la fe. Magdalena Lira, directora nacional de ACN (Ayuda a la Iglesia que sufre) en Chile, nos ofrece un panorama de la situación en el país, que se encuentra en observación en materia de libertad religiosa.

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.desc: Cristín, Eva, Enrique y Joseph son unos niños de 8 años que viven en la ciudad. En cada episodio, viajan con su imaginación a algún pasaje de la Biblia para vivir en directo los momentos más importantes de la historia de la salvación.

programme.title: La casita sobre la roca
programme.desc: Fray Juan enseña sobre la obediencia a la voluntad de Dios con la Parábola de la Casa sobre la roca. El padre tambien narra la historia de San Luis de Francia quien sabiamente obedeció a Dios y construyó su reino sobre la Roca que es Cristo.

programme.title: Mi familia católica
programme.desc: Martín y Sergio aprenden de la vida de San Martín de Porres, quien dedicó su vida a servir a los enfermos con mucha humildad, a pesar de haber recibido de Dios numerosos dones.

programme.title: El Rosario de los niños
programme.desc: Misterios Gloriosos: Meditación con dramatizaciones de los misterios Gloriosos sobre los momentos mas sobresalientes sobre la resurrección de nuestro Señor, Su Ascención, venida del Espíritu Santo, Asunción y coronación de la Vírgen María.

programme.title: Mi ratito con Jesús
programme.desc: Pablo, el primo de Cristín, va a ser bautizado. Los niños aprenden que con el bautismo nacemos a la vida de la gracia. Viajan con la imaginación hasta el río Jordán y ven cómo Jesús fue bautizado por san Juan Bautista.

programme.title: Cenáculos en familia
programme.desc: El primer capítulo presenta a la familia Noppe Moreno, que evangeliza con música y testimonios. Entre cantos y recuerdos, muestran cómo la oración fortalece, consuela en el dolor y une a la familia en el amor de Dios.

programme.title: Nuestra fe en vivo
programme.desc: En este programa Pepe Alonso nos regala una enseñanza más: “Sean Santos”. Para ello se basa en la Exhortación Apostólica “Gaudate Et Exsultate” del Papa Francisco que nos hace un llamado a la Santidad. “Todos estamos llamados a ser santos viviendo con amor y ofreciendo el propio testimonio en las ocupaciones de cada día, allí donde cada uno se encuentra'', Francisco.

programme.title: American Trends & Lifestyle Episode 14
programme.desc: This week on American Trends & Lifestyle, our new host Lauren Makk gets into the Halloween spirit with a look at Orlando’s seasonal fun and steps into the magical world of Willy Wonka. Plus, Trans-Siberian Orchestra celebrates 30 years of rocking the holidays, author Nathan Moris shares tips for meaningful life changes, and we go behind the scenes of the adventure thriller Heart of the Beast. We’ll also share important information to help those living with asthma better understand and manage their condition.

programme.title: Coffee with America Episode 639
programme.desc: This week on an all-new episode of Coffee with America, host Sasha Rionda celebrates fall with a coastal California getaway and smart strategies for navigating the season’s biggest sales. Plus, we share tips for protecting loved ones from online scams, managing fall allergens at home, and helping teen drivers stay safer behind the wheel. We’ll also travel to Costa Rica for a luxurious escape inspired by coffee traditions and head to Hong Kong for a colorful look at its Mid-Autumn Festival celebrations.

programme.title: Emily Harrington Talks New Feature Film, 'Girl Climber'
programme.desc: Legendary professional climber Emily Harrington talks about her experiences filming 'Girl Climber', her new feature documentary directed by John Glassberg and produced by Red Bull, in which she free climbs the Golden Gate route on El Cap in less than 24 hours. She talks about being one of the first women who become a prominent free climber in Yosemite, and the judgment she received accordingly.

programme.title: Climbing Words, Explained
programme.desc: Evan Wisheropp, Pro Climber, defines common climbing words. Send, means to to get to the top of a wall without falling or hanging on any safety gear. Onsight means to send a route on the first try, with no falls. Other terms like flash and trash refer to ways a climber might send a route. He also defines headpoint, meaning to scope a route on top route, greenpoint, brownpoint, and pinkpoint. On location explainer with original b-roll and graphics.

programme.title: Farm to Table
programme.desc: Sasha visits the local, organic farm that Boulder-based restaurant Zeal food uses to grow and source its produce.

programme.title: How to Test the Fit of Climbing Shoes
programme.desc: Climbing Contributor Matt Samet has been climbing shoe testing for about 25 years. He evaluates the fit of four pairs of shoes, giving pointers: Scarpa Instinct Lace (lace-up), Red Chili Voltage 2 (double velcro closure), Evolv Defy Velcro (single velcro closure), and Scarpa Instinct LE Slipper (no closure).

programme.title: 2024 YETI National Championships: Men's & Women's Lead Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: Lead Semi-Finals from Gaithersburg, MD. The USA Climbing National Team Trials for 2024 will take place at Sportrock Climbing Centers in Gaithersburg, MD from March 5th to March 8th. This prestigious event will showcase the top climbers in the country as they compete in three disciplines: Boulder, Lead, and Speed. The two highest-ranked U.S. athletes will earn a coveted spot on the U.S. National Team for 2024, allowing them to compete on the IFSC World Cup circuit. Some may even have the chance to compete in the Olympic Qualifying Series, where they will vie for additional spots on Team USA.

programme.title: How to Tape Your Hands for Crack Climbing
programme.desc: Crack Camp Climbing Guide Sam Foreman provides tips for how to tape your hands, optimized for crack climbing, in Indian Creek. He demonstrates steps like stretching skin before applying tape, wrapping tape two to three times around the palm, and taping past the wrists.

programme.title: Healthy on the Go: SEND Bars | No Days Off
programme.desc: Sasha and her business partners sit down to discuss the inspiration for Send Bars, Sashas newest business venture.

programme.title: Thunder Muscle
programme.desc: Sasha tries something new. After sending Thunder Muscle, 5.14a, Sasha returns to the climb with Tommy to shoot the entire route wearing a microphone, narrating her moves in an effort to give a little beta back to the climbing community.

programme.title: Carabiners 101
programme.desc: Genevive Walker, professional climber and Climbing contributor, talks us through the basics of carabiners, showing off different types and explaining their features, purposes, and uses. She covers d-shaped carabiners, oval carabiners, and HMS carabiners; locking carabiners including screwgate lockers, autolockers, and magnetic lockers; and gate types (straight gates and bent gates). A climber must understand how to use their gear properly.

programme.title: Meet the Women Behind the First Female Yosemite Triple Crown
programme.desc: Minidoc about the climber partnership between American climber Kate Kelleghan and French climber Laura Pineau. These women just bagged the Yosemite Triple Crown as the first female climbing partners to do so. Video produced by Thibaut Marot.

programme.title: 2024 YETI National Championships: Men's & Women's Speed Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2024 YETI National Championships will be held at the USA Climbing National Training Center in Salt Lake City, UT. Join us to cheer for Team USA and the world’s best competition climbers as IFSC World Cups return to Salt Lake City. The Boulder and Speed World Cup returns May 3-5, while the Paraclimbing World Cup returns May 7-8.

programme.title: Healthy on the Go: SEND Bars
programme.desc: Sasha and her business partners sit down to discuss the inspiration for Send Bars, Sashas newest business venture.

programme.title: Climbers We Lost in 2025
programme.desc: At the beginning of each year, we compile this tribute to climbers who passed away the year prior. The 2025 list includes 35 climbers, ranging in age from 18 to 90. Some died of natural causes, among family and friends. Others lost their lives in accidents involving free soloing, rappelling, and falls in the alpine.

programme.title: Home Means Nevada
programme.desc: Pro climber Alex Honnold explores the Las Vegas backyard he calls home. From Black Canyon to the peaks of Mt. Charleston, he climbs, hikes, and solos his favorite desert routes while reflecting on life, fame, family—and aliens.

programme.title: 2026 UIAA World Cup | Speed Finals
programme.desc: The UIAA Ice Climbing World Cup finals in Longmont, Colorado, are an annual winter event hosted at the Longmont Climbing Collective, featuring elite athletes competing in speed and lead climbing for world titles.

programme.title: Why Fall Practice Didn't Work for Me
programme.desc: Climbing Contributor Alice Hafer talks about a personal experience with a family member having a stroke, which psychologically affected her climbing negatively. She had a scary incident with a 5.12a project in Arizona's Virgin River Gorge, which she details to cast doubt on fall training always being a positive practice.

programme.title: Intro to Sport Climbing: Climbing Techniques CLIMB Ep 7 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Learn efficient, safe, and crucial fundamentals of sport climbing to achieve maximum fun at the crag. In this episode, pro climber Heather Weidner discusses climbing techniques, toproping, leading, managing fear, and more.

programme.title: 2024 YETI National Championships: Men's & Women's Boulder Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2024 YETI National Championships will be held at the USA Climbing National Training Center in Salt Lake City, UT. Join us to cheer for Team USA and the world’s best competition climbers as IFSC World Cups return to Salt Lake City. The Boulder and Speed World Cup returns May 3-5, while the Paraclimbing World Cup returns May 7-8.

programme.title: Respect Raptor Closures
programme.desc: Climbing Magazine associate editor, Sam Macilwaine, explains the importance of closing climbing routes to preserve bird nesting sites. Climbers can be good stewards of the outdoors by respecting closures and alerting land managers if they discover a raptor nest.

programme.title: 2023 National Team Trials: Women's & Men's Speed Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2023 USA Climbing National Team Trials presented by YETI is at the new Mesa Rim climbing facility in Austin, TX. For Team Trials, athletes compete in all three climbing disciplines Bouldering, Lead, and Speed. The 2023 U.S. National Team will comprise the top five ranked U.S. athletes per gender in each discipline, including a Boulder & Lead Team. In 2023, athletes from the newly formed Boulder & Lead Team and Speed Team will begin their quest to earn a spot for Team USA at the Paris 2024 Olympics. In speed climbing, athletes race against the clock and strive to set new records and achieve the fastest times possible. This fast-paced competition will leave you on the edge of your seat.

programme.title: Essential Self-Rescue for Climbers: Belaying from the Top CLIMB 16 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Learn basic self-rescue skills, and how to think critically in a climbing emergency. In this episode, guide and search-and-rescue pro Karsten Delap teaches you proper belaying from the top with different belay device styles.

programme.title: Review: Black Diamond Men’s Alpine Light Pants
programme.desc: Senior Editor at Climbing Magazine, Anthony Walsh, shares his review of the Black Diamond Alpine Light pants, which he says are the best all around climbing pants of 2025. He points out that they have light weather protection including PFC-free DWR finish, 4-way stretch, a gusseted crotch, articulated knees, and offer good breathable protection. He also notes the pockets are well placed, although he wishes there was an internal pocket garage for his phone. The pants are also sold in a women’s version.

programme.title: What Happens When There’s No Ice at Ice Fest?
programme.desc: Maya Silver, Editor-in-Chief at Climbing, talks about the 2026 Ouray Ice Fest, which up until the week before the event, had no ice. The organizers pivoted to an “ice-less” fest, and planned clinics around rock rescue, training for ice climbing, and dry tooling. Luckily, the week before the event, temperatures dropped and the park was able to create ice walls, but kept their planned schedule. Maya was able to learn to like dry tooling slightly more, and climb some empty ice.

programme.title: Little Brushy Opens to Climbers in Tennessee
programme.desc: Montage of climbing footage in Sequatchie Valley, Tennessee, with informational text popups. Until now, climbers have been unable to legally access Little Brushy. Access Fund and the Southeastern Climbers Coalition unlocked new access to the difficult sport climbing area, which will begin sometime this fall. There is also potential for additional route development and bouldering!

programme.title: The Art of Redpointing: Overcoming Obstacles CLIMB 22 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Unlock pro tips and world-class training techniques to get yourself redpoint ready. In this episode, pro climber Heather Weidner and mental-training expert Arno Ilgner teach you how to overcome the most common redpointing hurdles.

programme.title: The Best Ice Climbing Gear
programme.desc: Anthony Walsh, Senior Editor at Climbing Magazine, shares his reviews for some of the best ice climbing gear of the year. He recommends the La Sportiva G-Summit Boots, a double-booted model with a BOA fit system, as well as the Petzl Dart Crampon, which features a sharp bite. He also shares the Blue Ice Aero Ice Screw, which is the lightest steel screw on the market. He likes the updates to the Camp X-Dream Ice Tool, and finally reveals the Petzl Whisper Harness, which is lightweight and good for ice climbing.

programme.title: YETI Climbing National Championships 2026 - Lead Semi-Finals | USA Climbing

programme.title: Paddy'O Sucks at Climbing
programme.desc: PaddyO doesnt just suck at climbinghe actively dislikes it, insisting s a fear-based sport where the fun never shows up. Can national climbing champ Kai Lightner change his mind? Will PaddyOs dislike of sucking beat his dislike of being scared? Can he get his massive hooves into climbing shoes without crying like a baby? Great questions!

programme.title: Episode 10, Weekend Whipper — A 15-Foot Ground Fall
programme.desc: On this episode of Weekend Whipper, belayer Matt Gowie is traumatized when climber Luis Armando takes a a 15-foot fall, all the way to the ground. The route is 'Partners in Crime', a 5.11a trad climb in Squamish, British Columbia. On the ground, the climbing partners react to the crazy fall.

programme.title: Episode 8 | Weekend Whipper | Upside-Down in South Africa

programme.title: Climbings Newest Hotbed
programme.desc: Sasha travels to Manikia, a small village in Greece, to experience an emerging climbing destination. Manikia has only recently come into the spotlight as a potential world-class climbing destination. Sasha is joined on this adventure by fellow climbers from the Petzl team. The ultimate goal is to help establish a new climbing area the right way. During this trip, Sasha and the team set new routes in calibration with local climbers and guides while discussing ecotourism's positive and negative effects on local communities.

programme.title: Precision Footwork: Technique and Drills CLIMB Ep 9 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Learn to power your movement starting with your feet in order to climb to new heights. In this episode, pro climber Paige Claassen takes you through advanced moves and some drills to help up your footwork game.

programme.title: The Trilogy
programme.desc: On July 12, 2018, professional climber, Sasha DiGiulian, set out to become the first woman and second person in history to complete the Rocky Mountain Trilogy, a compilation of three of the hardest 5.14 big walls in the Canadian Rockies. The imposing climbs, on Castle Mountain, Mount Louis, and Mount Yamnuska, respectively will take Sasha 2 months of continued effort with the ultimate goal of ascending each sheer wall in a single day push, with zero falls — a combined average of over 9,000 vertical feet of climbing at a lung-busting average elevation of 7,000ft. Setbacks with climbing partners, a shoulder injury, and mounting wildfires, DiGiulian is faced with ever-increasing obstacles and forced to balance her goals with her safety. This is not only an extraordinarily unique physical journey, but a universal introspective story of overcoming fear, the importance of self-confidence, and finding friends when and where you least expect them. Pushing through the uncomfortable moments and riding the ups and downs of life, DiGiulian drives herself through mounting fatigue and a closing weather window to strive for her historical goal.

programme.title: One-Legged Injury Training in Boulder, CO

programme.title: Warren Miller's Any Snow Any Mountain (1971)
programme.desc: All you need are a pair of skis, snow, and a mountain to journey along in Warren Miller’s Any Snow Any Mountain. With an all star cast of skiers including Jim McConkey, Pepi Stiegler, Jon Reveal, Pat Bauman, Roger Staub and many others, Warren Miller takes you on a ski adventure of a lifetime. Follow along as Warren takes you to some of the best powder filled mountains on the planet. From Squaw Valley, up to Whistler B.C., over to Steamboat, and all the way to Japan, see what the original mono-ski looked like, watch as two people try to go down the mountain on the same skis, and witness for yourself the birth of airborn skiing. Warren Miller’s Any Snow Any Mountain will prove to you that you don’t need much to get out there and ski.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Snowriders 2 (1997)
programme.desc: Snowriders 2 shows that there's definitely more than one way to get down a mountain. Whether its outpacing an oncoming avalanche, kayaking through the snow at 50 miles per hour, windsurfing on fresh powder in Alaska or heli-skiing with disabled skiers, "Snowriders 2" explodes with excitement as world-class snowriders take to the slopes. Snowriders 2 picks up where last year's "Snowriders" left off, bringing audiences more of the world's top skiers and snowboarders, jaw-dropping action and adventure in exotic locations. And, of course, Warren Miller's dry wit and hauntingly familiar voice. The result: an experience that feels more like a thrill ride than a movie.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Limitless Lines | Warren Miller Vault
programme.desc: It’s time to get your winter stoke on - it's the Warren Miller Half-Hour!

programme.title: Warren Miller's Black Diamond Rush (1993)
programme.desc: Come see what it’s like to ski like a real pro and feel the thrill of a Black Diamond Rush with truly extreme skiers like Seth Morrison, Tamara McKinney, Brad Vancour, Chris Tamborini, and loads more. Trek from black diamond run to black diamond run in places like Iceland, Transylvania, Chile, as well as North America and find out what all the buzz is about.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Born To Ski (1991)
programme.desc: We were all born for a reason, and many people have found out that they were "Born to Ski." Join others who were born for the same thing like Bill Heath, Nelson Carmichael, Diana Golden, the Egan brothers, Brad Vancour and plenty more as they do the one thing they were born to do: ski. Travel to places like Canada, Oregon, Chile, France, Japan, even Yugoslavia and find out if skiing is what you were born to do also.

programme.title: Warren Miller's California Skis (1951)
programme.desc: Enjoy the first 10 minutes of the captivating 2nd film of Warren Miller's "1951 California Skis," which takes us on a nostalgic journey back to the early days of skiing culture in Southern California. This time capsule of a film offers a glimpse into the thrilling world of skiing in the 1950s, showcasing the passion and camaraderie of the skiing community. From the breathtaking snowy slopes of the San Bernardino Mountains to the lively après-ski gatherings in cozy lodges, the film captures the essence of this exhilarating sport and its vibrant culture.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Carving Out a Legacy | Warren Miller Vault
programme.desc: It’s time to get your winter stoke on - it's the Warren Miller Half-Hour!

programme.title: Above the Clouds, Beyond the Edge with Warren Miller | Warren Miller Vault

programme.title: Warren Miller's Chasing Shadows (2015)
programme.desc: This fall, Warren Miller Entertainment introduces its 66th snowsports film, Chasing Shadows. Watch JT Holmes, Seth Wescott, Caroline Gleich, Steven Nyman and more as they pursue turns on the mountains of our dreams: Chamonix, Alaska’s Chugach, Utah’s Wasatch and the mightiest range of them all: the Himalaya. These athletes are masters in their element, and with every cliff drop, perfect line and knee-deep powder turn, they motivate us. Warren Miller once said, “A pair of skis are the ultimate transportation to freedom,” and this year, we’re chasing storms, snow, lines and the freedom they grant us. Take a glimpse into the world of the U.S. freestyle team and the dynamics of snowsports that live on the fringe, like monoskiing, powsurfing and speed riding. Explore what it means to be inspired, and what it is about exotic locations and snow-covered summits that keep us searching for more. As skiers and snowboarders we chase a feeling, a memory, a storm, a turn — we’ve been chasing it our whole lives and we’ll keep chasing it a lifetime more. Winter starts with Warren Miller.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Children Of Winter (2008)
programme.desc: We’re called by untouched faces begging for tracks; by unbuilt jumps begging for a shovel, unclimbed mountains begging for someone to stand atop them and declare: Winter’s open for business. Meet Daron Rahlves, Pep Fujas, Wendy Fisher, Jamie Pierre, Seth Wescott, Andreas Hatveit, surfing legend Gerry Lopez, and many more, as they tell stories of ascents and descents, huge air and a few scares, from the mountains of Alaska, Colorado, Austria, Iceland, and beyond. Save for a few more feet of air and the touch of their turns, they’re just like us.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Cold Fusion (2001)
programme.desc: Pack your bags and come along as skiers and riders like Chris Anthony, Rob Kingwill, JP Auclair, Vincent Dorion, Justin Patnode, Jussi Oksanen, and many more travel to some of the most bizarre ski destinations on the planet. From all of the familiar places like Colorado, Canada, and Alaska to some new places like Iran and Kenya Warren Miller takes you on an unforgettable ski adventure.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Climb to Glory: Legacy of the 10th Mountain Ski Troopers (2013)
programme.desc: Climb to Glory tells the story of the 10th Mountain Division Ski Troopers and how they transformed skiing as a whole and championed the U.S. Ski In­dustry after World War II. After participating in a major turning point in the War, these heroes came back from Italy as pioneering individuals and helped expand skiing from general resort develop­ment to a lifestyle sport . Narrated by Olympian and Colorado Ski & Snowboard Museum inductee Jeremy Bloom and inspired by Warren Miller Athlete Chris Anthony, "Climb to Glory" highlights their astounding impact to our country and the ski industry.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Dynasty (2009)
programme.desc: Warren Miller’s Dynasty takes you on a breathtaking global tour of China, Alaska, Norway, Colorado, British Columbia, and more. Join legendary WME athlete Chris Anthony as he treks into China’s interior on a search for the birthplace of skiing; follow mountaineering marvel Chris Davenport to Norway’s highest peaks; reunite with the pride of the Midwestern ski community, Luke and Adam Schrab; and catch a rare glimpse at historic clips from Warren Miller Entertainment’s vault of vintage footage.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Double Exposure (1985)
programme.desc: An adrenaline-charged ride into the world of extreme skiing, this film follows two legendary brother duos—the Egans and the DesLauriers—as they conquer towering peaks and treacherous descents. programme.title: Warren Miller's Endless Winter (1995)
programme.desc: Warren Miller Entertainment is poised to kick off the 1995-96 ski season with a whirlwind tour of North America showcasing their newest film, “Endless Winter.” Miller’s cameras chased the world’s best skiers and snowboarders across four continents to create “Endless Winter.” From Alaska to Argentina and Jackson Hole to Japan, skiers and snowboarders enjoyed epic snow conditions the world over. Kurt Miller, son of the award-winning filmmaker and co-owner of Warren Miller Entertainment with partner Peter Speek, reported, “Our camera crews brought home more outstanding footage than ever before. ‘Endless Winter’ is sure to be a record-breaker!”

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On July 4, 1987, seven inmates broke out of a high-security prison in New Mexico. In a dangerous manhunt and race against time, authorities and scientists used the Bureau's crime laboratory to catch these dangerous criminals.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Boston, FBI agents tracked down a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns. As the robberies grew increasingly more violent, authorities launched a complex sting to trap the deadly ring of thieves.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Dartmouth Professors Susanne and Half Zantop are found brutally murdered in their quaint New Hampshire home. Colleagues confirm that the couple was very well liked. programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A series of bizarre shootings terrorized the small town of East Point, Georgia and left two people dead and two others critically wounded. programme.title: The FBI Files

In an investigation spanning from Georgia to South America, police, the DEA and the FBI worked together to take down this dangerous drug ring.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home. FBI agents collected fibers from her bedroom and discovered, through the use of laser light sources, a palm print on Polly's bed. After a massive two-month investigation, the FBI arrested Richard Allen Davis. Would the palm prints and fibers match?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1982, a California highway patrol officer pulled a young woman over for speeding. He bullied her into sex and then killed her. He then used a decade of police experience to try to cover up his crime and convince investigators of his innocence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The calm of a Southern Ohio's quiet community was shattered in 1989, when a sniper gunned down an outdoorsman without reason. Hiding in the distance, behind a high powered rifle, a madman was hunting humans along Ohio's county roads.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A young mother and her two daughters were sexually assaulted and brutally murdered in Anchorage, Alaska. programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.desc: The outlaw Jesse James and his friend are on the run from the law when he is wrongly accused of leading the historic 1876 Northfield, Minnesota bank robbery. With nerve-tensing turns and high-impact action, Jesse rides into a town where a gang is trying to drive area ranchers off their land because there's oil underneath it. Jesse James takes particular interest in the situation of a pretty young woman and her elderly father, whose ranch is being regularly attacked by the gang.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: He likes his whiskey hard... His women soft... And his west all to himself! Inspired by Shakespeares The Taming of the Shrew (1594), John Wayne (The Searchers, Stagecoach), Maureen OHara (Miracle on 34th Street, The Parent Trap), and Patrick Wayne (The Searchers, The Alamo) star in this western comedy directed by Andrew V. McLaglen (Gunsmoke, The Wild Geese). George Washington McLintock (John Wayne) is the wealthiest man in his territory who utilizes his power and influence to maintain order between farmers, ranchers, Indians, corrupt government officials, and his own family! McLintock is McNificent!

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures!

programme.title: Lost Canyon
programme.desc: When Johnny Travers (Jay Kirby) is falsely accused of robbing a bank, it's up to Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) to clear his name and find the real villains. There's nothing better than watching Hoppy get rough with the rustlers, and it's all the better when you get to hear the Sportsmen Quartette sing (I got Spurs) Jingle, Jangle, Jingle.

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: Bob's Playin' A Mystery Hand... He's Marked For Death By Killer Bullets As Gunfire Echoes Over The Plains! After one of his ranch hands is killed when a gang attacks his ranch, Jim Roberts joins forces with his neighbor in an effort to fight off the Bennett Cattle Co., a company looking to rob them of their land. Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as Fuzzy Q. Jones.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Randolph Scott plays James Barlow, an agent from Chicago hired to bring the notorious Reno brothers to justice. But wouldnt you know it? The Reno gang includes a beautiful young woman (Mala Powers), who catches Barlows eye. This western from director Tim Whelan (The Thief of Bagdad) features cinematography by two-time Oscar winner Ray Rennahan (Gone With The Wind), while the screenplay was by noted author Horace McCoy (They Shoot Horses, Dont They?). Theres also an all-star cast, including Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Edgar Buchanan, Denver Pyle, and several other shaggy sidewinders!

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: Cowboy star Bob Steele (Valley of Hunted Men, The Trail Blazers) headlines this Poverty Row western drama. As the Colorado Kid, he's falsely arrested for murder and has to clear himself. The colorful cast includes Ernie Adams, Frank LaRue, and Horace Murphy, with direction by Sam Newfield (The Terror of Tiny Town, The Mad Monster).

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Red Ryder: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
programme.desc: Red Ryder encounters bandits trying to hold up the stagecoach carrying the owner of the Devil's Hole newspaper, Libby Brooks and her brother Gerry. Red successfully drives off the attackers but becomes embroiled in further conflict, leading to a duel that nearly claims his life.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A THRILLING TALE OF REVENGE AND REDEMPTION! Based on the story Triple Cross for Danger by the widely lauded Western author Walter J. Coburn, Fighting Fury is a thrilling take on the Western revenge drama. Portraying both a father and his son, star of silent and sound cowboy adventure films, Jack Hoxie (Trouble Busters, Law and Lawless) exudes the classic American rustic charm that still defines the genre. The film spins the yarn of Clay Hill Jr. (Hoxie), a Spanish-American boy raised by a Mexican servant who vows bloody vengeance on three malicious ranchers after they murder his parents and turn his life upside down. Featuring fine supporting performances from genre heavies Helen Holmes, Buck Conners and Western mainstay Fred Kohler.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Ablaze with guns and guts and glory! Randolph Scott headlines as a star studded cast in this yarn about battling homesteaders. Director Edwin L. Marin (Tall in the Saddle) spins this dramatic post-Civil War tale that takes place in the legendary cow town of Abilene, Kansas, coaxing fine performances from the likes of Ann Dvorak, Edgar Buchanan, Thonda Fleming, and Lloyd Bridges. Saddle up and hang on!

programme.title: Shine on Harvest Moon
programme.desc: Jackson and his gang are cattle rustlers holed up in Jackson Hole Wyoming. Roy's partner Brower was once Jackson's partner and is now suspected of being in cahoots with him. Someone is tipping off Jackson as to the cattle's whereabouts and when Roy learns who it is he has a plan to trap Jackson and clear his partner. Starring Roy Rogers, Lynne Roberts, and Myrtle Wiseman as 'Lulu Belle. Directed by Joseph Kane.

programme.title: Days of Jesse James
programme.desc: Famed American western actor and singer Roy Rogers once again plays himself in this Jesse James tale that's a twist on the familiar formula. When he is summoned to bring Jesse to justice after the known villain is suspected of a bank robbery, Rogers soon discovers that Jesse has been framed and that the owner of the bank has robbed his own bank posing as Jesse. Fast-paced and fun, this classic Roy Rogers western directed by Joseph Kane (Dakota) features a whole host of original songs sung by the great Rogers himself.

programme.title: How the Universe Works S2 - "Cosmic Firestorms"

programme.title: How the Universe Works S2 - "Clockwork and Creation"

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon checks in to Connecticuts oldest inn, the Curtis House. This historic inn has been run by the Hardisty family for generations, but the business has started to fall apart and the family legacy is on the brink of being lost. The inn is currently run by brother and sister, T.J and Chris, but they no longer speak to each other and the staff and guests are stuck in the middle. Can Gordon save the historic inn and rescue a family at breaking point? And what will Gordon make of Betty, the inns resident ghost who he has to share a bedroom with?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to the Historic Calumet Inn, in Pipestone, Minnesota. Joint owners, Vanda and Rina Smrkovski were given the inn as a gift by their father (who they still call daddy), and they treat it with less respect than a dolls house. These spoilt little girls have been playing hotel for nine months, and their idle behavior has left the staff working double time, and on the brink of revolt, and their guests suffering. Gordon quickly realizes that daddys little girls need to grow up, and fast, if hes going to have a chance of saving this place. Will the wheels on the bus keep going round and round, or have they already come off?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits a Caribbean style resort hotel in Fort Pierce, Florida where the young inexperienced owner, Brian is making guests time at the hotel miserable with filthy rooms, late night concerts and shocking service. Brian has lost control, leaving the hotel staff to run wild. Gordon quickly realizes hes going to need something short of a miracle if hes going to stop this place from going under water.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Island Park, Idaho to try and rescue the failing Anglers Lodge. Despite building the stunning lodge with his own hands, owner Dave Ebey has lost his passion and it has almost cost him his business. Gordon discovers a family tragedy has devastated the Ebeys and caused them to shy away from the hotel and the community. Gordon is desperate to help this couple at their breaking point but is he too late?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Harpers Ferry in West Virginia, to try to save a historic hotel thats desperately in need of help. Karan Townsend, the owner, runs the hotel like a thrift store and hoards junk everywhere. Under Karans management the business and the hotel have started to fall apart. Gordon gets the shock of his life as he witnesses the worst dinner service he has ever had the misfortune to see. This disaster of a hotel could be too much for even Gordon Ramsay to save.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon continues his mission to fix the failing Towns Inn in Harpers Ferry, West Virginia despite having to shut down the hotel after witnessing some shocking food practices. These are some of the worst Ramsay has encountered; some so serious they threaten the lives of the guests, as well as the life of the hotel. Gordon is left in even more disbelief as he uncovers some even more terrifying cleanliness issues.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: The Vienna owners Jonathan and Lisa Krach are at their breaking point and have become trapped in their Austrian themed hotel, drowning in debt. Gordon discovers some shocking rumors about the owners and the real reason customers have stopped coming to the European inspired Inn. Can Gordon keep the doors to this historic hotel open, or is he too late?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Newtown in Pennsylvania, to try and save a historic hotel that is desperately in need of help. Verindar, the owner, runs the hotel like an angry tyrant. Her staff is ready to quit because they are so unhappy with the way they are treated. The terrible reputation of The Brick has forced the community to turn their back on this once precious and historical landmark. Can Gordon save the historic hotel and rescue a staff ready to break?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to the luxury Lakeview Hotel in Lake Chelan, Washington. Owner Brent is at a loss, as he watches his dreams of being a success fail miserably. The bedrooms are empty and the hotels restaurant and ice cream parlor are failing. Gordon is shocked to witnesses the most inappropriate and penny-pinching owner he has ever met. Can Gordon save this boutique hotel or is the owner beyond his help?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Loudonville, Ohio, to try to rescue the failing Landolls Mohican Castle. Despite spending millions of dollars to construct the family-built European style castle, the business has started to fall apart and a family legacy is on the brink of being lost. Co-owner Marta has been left with the entire burden of The Castle resting on her shoulders after her husband walked away from the hotel due to a bitter divorce. Jimmie, her son, has stepped in as the restaurants cook but without any culinary experience he is forced to look up how to make dishes by watching online videos as he stands over the stove. Although Jimmie is trying to help, his actions are causing more harm than good. Can Gordon turn this family around before the hotel and the family legacy are destroyed?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Cambridge, New York, where ex-military man John Imhof and his wife, Tina, own and run the allegedly haunted Cambridge Hotel. General John runs the hotel like a dictatorship, an approach thats driving the staff crazy and the guests straight out the door. Gordons stay at the hotel is genuinely terrifying, but its not the ghost that keeps him awake, its something far worse.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits The Keating, a luxury boutique hotel in San Diego, CA. The Keatings supercar-obsessed owner, Eddie Kaen, has blown millions designing the hotel to look like an Italian sports car, but neglected to spend money on things the guests really need. The rooms are empty, the hotels restaurant is failing and the staff have reached their limit, leading to a truly shocking crisis that no one saw coming.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to The River Rock Inn in Milford Pennsylvania, where owner Ken Pisciotta is over his head and drowning in debt. Unable to get any guests to stay in his neglected inn, Ken has all but given up, and his constant negativity is making the entire staff question whether lifes too short to continue working there. Can Gordon get the River Rock back on track before Ken loses everything?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to the Juniper Hill Inn in Windsor, VT, a place that looks like a million dollars but smells of raw sewage. He meets the inns wealthy and arrogant owner, Robert Dean II, and uncovers his shocking treatment of his staff. Gordon quickly realizes its going to need something approaching a miracle if hes going to have a chance of saving this place.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Its Gordons greatest challenge to date, as he continues to uncover problem after problem at Vermonts Juniper Hill Inn. He tries to help the staff against arrogant owners Robert and Ari, but after catching one of them in a shocking lie, Gordon feels he has no choice but to do something hes never done before. Abandon ship.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Coeur DAlene, Idaho, to try to rescue the failing Roosevelt Inn. Despite being over a million dollars in debt, the Roosevelt's owner, John Hough, is more interested in telling jokes and dressing up as Sherlock Holmes than he is in fixing his struggling B&B. To make matters worse, John's wife Tina is ready to run away from the inn and from her buffoon of a husband. Can Gordon get through to John before he destroys both his business and his marriage?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits The Keating, a luxury boutique hotel in San Diego, CA. The Keatings supercar-obsessed owner, Eddie Kaen, has blown millions designing the hotel to look like an Italian sports car, but neglected to spend money on things the guests really need. The rooms are empty, the hotels restaurant is failing and the staff have reached their limit, leading to a truly shocking crisis that no one saw coming.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits Meson de Mesilla, a luxury Tuscan-style hotel in Las Cruces, New Mexico. Owner and child-star, Cali Szczawinski, purchased the hotel to perform Cher songs every night to a captive audience. Too busy trying to hit the high notes on stage (the hotel has three of them), Cali has failed to notice that shes falling flat when it comes to what her hotel guests need. The bedrooms are empty, the hotels restaurant is failing, and Gordon witnesses a shocking exit that no one saw coming. Can Gordon turn back time? Or is this boutique hotel, and its singing owner, beyond his help?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Tim Gray is 21. Hes the Head Chef at Bonapartes in Silsden, West Yorkshire and he specializes in fine dining. He has ambitions to be a TV chef and one day hopes to open restaurants in London, Paris and New York. Unfortunately, as Gordon Ramsay discovers, Tim cant even cook an omelets and when he attempts to make dinner for his parents at home he manages to set the cooker alight. A true kitchen nightmare if ever you saw one. With no customers and a fridge full of fancy ingredients, Bonapartes is losing money fast. Owner Sue Ray has run out of ideas. Shes never owned a restaurant before and has been led astray by Tims enthusiasm for vanilla fumes and balsamic reductions. Ramsay soon establishes that what the people of Silsden really want to eat is Beef and Ale Pie and Treacle Tart and when he gets the menu back to basics the restaurant is chocker block. But can Tim cope with a full dining room when he hasnt ever cooked for more than 6 people at once? And will this simplistic style of cooking satisfy his hungry ambition?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Saturday night at the Glass House Restaurant in Ambleside is a nightmare. Orders in the kitchen are mixed up, foods not cooked properly and the customers are complaining. Not only is the chef in tears, but the owners on the brink as well. Neil Farrells owned the Lake District restaurant for 3 years and hes up to this eyes in debt. The business wont survive if the restaurants only busy on a Saturday night but with only 3,000 residents in the town, Neil has to attract the influx of visitors if hes going to fill the 90 seats every night. Gordon Ramsay rolls up his sleeves and gets involved in every detail of the business from scrubbing the grimy, slimy kitchen walls to teaching the waiters how to sell the food. He decides that the head chef is the weak link and sets about getting the kitchen in order. Ramsays not one to tread lightly - the waiter is told he has bad breath, the kitchen porters given a bollocking for dropping the cutlery, and owners invited outside for his criticisms of Ramsays Caesar salad. When Ramsay takes the head chef out of the equation, he discovers a great deal of talent in the young cooks.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The Walnut Tree Inn is in trouble theres no head chef, the customers have dwindled, and the owner has had to sell the family home to keep the business afloat. The Walnut Tree Inn in South Wales became a national institution under the ownership of Franco and Ann Tauscher, who successfully ran it for 37 years. But when fellow Italian Francesco bought the place 3 years ago he made the mistake of turning the warm and welcoming country inn into a cold and stark London-style restaurant. He achieved a Michelin star for the food but soon after that he lost his head chef. Donning his chefs whites and apron, Francesco tries to run the kitchen and be the host in the restaurant. Consequently he fails in both jobs. The customers arent returning and the foods going downhill. Ramsays first job is to recruit a new head chef so the owner can woo the customers and stop meddling in the kitchen. But hes also intent on making the dining room a cosier place and scotching rumours by bringing the previous owners back to lend Francesco their support for the Walnut Trees 40th Anniversary celebrations.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Nick and Richard are self-confessed restaurant virgins. Theyve both had successful careers in the brewery business so when they bought Moore Place last summer they thought their dream had come true. What they hadnt fathomed was just how difficult it would be to fill the 90-seater oak-paneled restaurant or find a chef who could cook decent food. Their first mistake was to paint the building purple. The wealthy Surrey residents hated it and refuse to enter the building. Weve got gold medals in fucking it up, admits Richard, and he cant think of a single evening when the restaurants run smoothly. Ramsay discovers some fundamental problems a chef who cant cook, a bunch of sultry waiters and a building that looks more like a funeral parlour than a restaurant. Can these brewery whizz-kids turn this former failing Berni Inn into a profitable business when they are continually faced with never-ending staff problems and a complete lack of know-how in the kitchen? If theyre going to succeed Ramsay has to teach them the rudiments of running a restaurant before they can even think of making a profit.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for the first programme of the new series is La Lanterna in Letchworth, Hertfordshire. Twenty- eight-year-old owner and head chef Alex offers modern Italian cuisine, a taste of Little Italy in Englands first garden city, and the restaurant is run by his best mate maitre d Gavin, helped by his ex-air hostess girlfriend Emily. But Alex has no customers, cookers that dont work and an expensive menu thats about as authentically Italian as a spag bol. He re-mortgaged his house to buy the business, its losing 1,000 a week, he hasnt slept for months but still runs round town in a flash car (number plate: A1CHEF) thats worth more than the restaurant. Running out of money, inspiration and energy, Alex is on the verge of losing everything. Gordon rolls up his sleeves and sets to work on the encrusted kitchen cookers and hapless front-of-house staff. Can a strict diet of brutal honesty, radical food surgery and undiluted energy turn things round, or is it only a matter of time before the lights go out at La Lanterna for good?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for tonights second programme is D-Place in Chelmsford, Essex run by Mexican born Israel and his English partner Tara. Theyve sunk 150,000 of their own money into their trendy caf bar which offers a vast selection of fusion cuisine. In charge is Executive Chef Philippe, producing everything from all-day breakfasts to hoi sin noodles with an astounding lack of flair; the plastic food is dire and boomerangs back from the dining room as soon as its cooked. Restaurant manager, spunky Essex boy Dave, loathes his chef, and their mutual hatred spills over into permanent running battles. Faced with dysfunctional staff and a disastrous menu, Gordon is about to face the longest week of his professional life. Can he quell the panic, banish the deep fat fryer and bring D-Place back from the dead, or will it disappear forever?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for tonights third programme is Momma Cherris Soul Food Shack, an intimate forty- seater a stones throw from Brightons sea front. Big soul momma, owner CHARITA JONES, produces a menu of irresistibly unique classics from the Deep South. The foods hard to fault but the punters are nowhere to be seen, Head Chef Brian and a rag-tag collection of part-timers are taking the mickey - and despite working a seven-day week Charitas got an empty restaurant and a 65,000 debt. If ever there was a case of too many cooks, this is it. Charitas a natural, but shes never made a profit on the restaurant and is now facing financial disaster. Can Gordon successfully shut her out of the kitchen, get the chef back on the boil and put the soul back into the business, or will the shack shut up shop for good?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for tonights fourth programme is La Riviera, a fine dining restaurant in Inverness. Owned by multi-millionaire Barry Larson and costing 8000 a week to run, the place boasts top French chef Loic Lefebvre and an impeccably-trained kitchen staff with Michelin star studded backgrounds. Loic is on a mission, to bring sophisticated French cooking to the home of haggis, tatties and deep-fried Mars bars. But though hes hungry for success, hes arrogant and the foods pretentious. The locals arent biting and the restaurants empty most nights. Theres a sharp smell of dj vu in the air for Gordon whose own venture in Scotland - Amaryllis - had to close. This week its personal as Ramsay tries to save La Riviera from the same fate. Can Gordon tone down their act, demystify the menu and, most importantly, get the punters in?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for tonights program is Clubway 41, despite being voted Blackpool Tourist Board Restaurant of the year, the place is dire straits. It is the prime example of HOW NOT TO RUN A RESTAURANT. Owner DAVE is the flakey self-appointed head chef, who hasnt been in a kitchen for 30 years and cant cook. His partner DAWN invents bizarre dishes for the menu, ranging from tomato and cointreau soup to pork with brie, nectarine and whiskey sauce. Gordon faces a hellish week as Clubway 41 is breaking every rule in book. Can he bring Dave, Dawn and their food back down to earth?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Tonights program sees Gordon Ramsay in Oscars in Nantwich. On the surface this place seems idyllic, an Irish family run restaurant in the heart of beautiful countryside. Owner MAURA runs the front of house and her son LENIN is the Head chef, but its not happy families. With her life savings on the line Maura is in big trouble. She constantly bickers with her son whilst the customers are forced to wait hours for their fluorescent crab stick paellas, and stodgy carbonaras from Oscars bit of everything menu. The place is losing 2000 per week, but that isnt the worst of their problems, Lenin has got a serious drink problem and during service collapses and has to be rushed off to hospital. Its Gordons toughest challenge yet; can he bring the Irish heart back to Oscars, stop mother and son fighting, and get the Lenin to face up to his problems?

programme.title: One Day One Trouble
programme.desc: All hell breaks loose when Ego, a troublemaker, visits her brother's house and causes problems in his relationship.

programme.title: Ghost Baby
programme.desc: A group of mischievous ghosts, led by a child, haunts a community causing mayhem everywhere, while dealing with their own supernatural issues.

programme.title: The Weekend
programme.desc: A woman discovers a heart-breaking secret. She plans a steamy intimate weekend with her husband, but this weekend is full of questions, anger, rage and blood. She will not stop until she gets her answers.

programme.title: Stanley on the Go
programme.desc: Stanley Siegel, the late broadcaster, known to millions for his groundbreaking and often controversial interviews on WABC-and with Stanley On The Go he single-handedly redefines the travel show. Indeed, he redefines the notion of adventure: you don't have to be a young Olympian to have a zest for life. Experience shouldn't - and doesn't - end at 60. Stanley shows that there's more to retirement than bingo and shuffleboard on the Lido deck. He's an inspiration. Stanley takes us headlong around the globe: whether he's on a camel in Giza, the deck of a Navy aircraft carrier off San Diego, straddling a speeding motorbike through the streets of Moscow, or balancing on top of the Sydney Harbor Bridge, each episode is a tour de force with a force of nature. Stanley is irrepressible, his commentary is not only informative and enlightening, but is also often surprising and frequently irreverent. He shows us the iconic sights-the Grand Tour-but also uncovers the unexpected.

programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Fighters Only 17th Annual World MMA Award Show from Las Vegas hosted by UFC Hall of Famer Chael Sonnen. The fan-voted event covers the sport’s biggest performances and major storylines over the last year featuring star-studded presenters and features the major performance categories such as knockout of the year and fight of the year as well as the lifetime achievement award. Presenters include Maxx Crosby, Neal McDonough, Akbar Gbaja-Biamila, Frank Mir, Bella Mir, Millennium All Stars, Jon Anik, Valentin Chmerkovskiy, K-La Duncan, Nina Drama, Lochlyn Munro, Natalie Lind, Dr. Octagon and Shawne Merriman

programme.title: UFA 489 - 8IGHT Strikes: Standup Mixed Martial Arts part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents 8IGHT Strikes Standup MMA part 1 from the Woolwich Works Arena in London with eight strikes scoring. First up is a female matchup in the lightweight division between Karolina Kadzielawa and the more experienced Molly McCulloch. In the next bout with Full Thai Rules, Frank Mulley takes on Shea Patton with an undefeated record. In a welterweight feature fight of the night, "The Boy" Ryan Moore steps into the ring with Saj Imran.

programme.title: UFA 490 - 8IGHT Strikes: Standup Mixed Martial Arts part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents 8IGHT Strikes Standup MMA part 2 from the Woolwich Works Arena in London with eight strikes scoring. Starting off this episode, undefeated Josh Gravesande takes on AJ Durrani in a bantamweight contest. In the next bout, Harry Moore takes on the more experienced Lyes Marinko in the welterweight division. In the main event, Mo Abdurahman takes on lias Krafi for the Featherweight World Title with Full Thai rules and no elbows in this matchup between South Africa and Morocco.

programme.title: UFA 491 - Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor in Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features a middleweight kickboxing tournament with Darius Olteam versus Edmond Mustafa, Cezar Buzdugan versus Stefan Vranceanu, Andre Varga versus Cristian Neacșu and Laurenti-Gabi Fatiol versus Albert Enache. The winners of each of these quarter finals will move to the next round in the championship tournament.

programme.title: UFA 493 - Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 2 from the Sala Sporturilor in Targu Jiu, Romania. Tonight features two heavyweight matchups and the finals of the middleweight tournament. In the first heavyweight bout Petrisor Gananau faces Leonard Ioncila in an Entertainment Boxing Match. Next up is a kickboxing Super Fight in the heavyweight division with Tibor Varga facing undefeated Vasile Corcodel in a Hungary versus Maldova faceoff. In a boxing matchup in the Super Middleweight division, Valentin Cioaca faces Veronel Tarau. The main event is the final of the eight man pyramid tournament to determine the DFS Middleweight Champion.

programme.title: UFA 483 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 1 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. In a Welterweight bout, Fedya Chobanyan steps into the ring with Jeffrey Bishop in a Welterweight bout followed by a match in the Featherweight division when Matthew Nester takes on Joshua Brown, making his pro-debut. In the main event, the UNF Flyweight title is on the line when Trevor Wells, a protégé of Conor Mcgregor challenges Mexican lawyer Gianni Vasquez

programme.title: UFA 487 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 2 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. Up first in the bantamweight division, Sammy Caceres steps into the cage with Jose Hernandez. In a featherweight contest Attila Erret takes on Cole Smith while Travis Horn and Minsuh Jung face off in a middlewight bout. In the main event the flyweight title is on the line when Pargev Khachatrian takes on Nathan Hawthorne in a grappler versus strker contest.

programme.title: UFA 492 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 3 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. In a flyweight bout, Artur Arutyunyan faces Josh Pavia and Narek Avagyan steps into the cage with Rodney Kealohi. In the main event, the Rising Stars Lightweight Belt is on the line when the undefeated Izac Enriquez puts his title on the line against Weston Quiroz.

programme.title: UFA 496 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 4
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 4 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. The first bout is in the Featherweight division and places Rafayel Ktikyan against Michael Williams in a battle of the undefeated. Next up, Bryen Dao steps into the cage with Carlos Figueroa for a Featherweight bout. In the main event, the UNF Bantamweight Title is on the line as David Rojas takes on Eduardo Zarate, "The Peruvian Nightmare."

programme.title: UFA 497 - UFA’s Baddest Babes – Best of part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Best of Baddest Babes part 1 with an action-packed episode featuring all female fighters showcasing the skill, strength and personalities of women redefining the world of combat sports. Bouts include SFT: Bianca Sattelmayer versus Florencia Greco, TuffNUff: Roma Pawelek versus Aspen Ladd, NAAFS: Tecia Torres versus Rebecca Gruitza, SFT: Julia Polastri versus Jessica Cunha, BTC: Lindsay Garbatt versus Rayanne Dos Santos and SFC: Lainey Nations versus Stormie Kilgore

programme.title: UFA 499 - UFA’s Baddest Babes – Best of part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Best of Baddest Babes part 2 with an action-packed episode featuring all female fighters showcasing the skill, strength and personalities of women redefining the world of combat sports. Bouts include SFT: Camila Santos versus Ruth Ravena, Breakthrough MMA: Caitlin Sammons versus Jessica Borga, TuffNUff MMA: Jessica Branco versus Cheyanne Vlismas, SFT: Gisele Moreira versus Daiane Firmino,CFL: Maraya Miller versus Alenita Perez, TuffNUff: Brieta Carpenter versus Serena DeJesus and Ronda Rousey versus Autumn Richardson.

programme.title: UFA 500 - SFT Combat 63
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents SFT Combat 63 from Sao Paolo, Brazil. Up first, an Xtreme fight in the heavyweight division between Pedro Orlando and Breno Souza and in the flyweight division, Paulo Andre and Bruno Brito step into the cage. In an Xtreme Karate bout, Caique Korchak faces Luiz Soares plus in an MMA catchweight bout, Joab Baianinho and Vitor Showman faceoff. In an Xtreme female matchup, Maju Bertin and Giovanna Bonanome take to the cage in what's expected to be a striking battle.

programme.title: UFA 441 - Up Next Fighting – Migran vs. Douglas
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting: Migran Vs. Douglas from Southern California. In this episode "Westside" Dion Young looks to replicate his KO of the night when he steps into the cage with Sexyama Albert Lee. In a featherweight championship bout, Hamzeh Trad and undefeated Shane Collins take to the cage in a battle for the belt. In the main event, Olympic silver medalist Migran "The Maestro" Arutyunyan faces off against David "Tarzan" Douglas.

programme.title: UFA 370 - CFC 17 Rex Mundi
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championship 17 Rex Mundi from Rio De Janeiro. Up first Maruicio Otalora faces Eduardo Souza and Thiago Lima arm-bar specialist takes on the explosive Andre Borges. Also fighting tonight William Baraka and Jiolton Lutterbach and the winner of the Souza-Lima faces Ronys Torres in the finals of the four-man tournament.

programme.title: UFA 425 - Red Owl BoxFest XIV part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl Boxfest XIV part 1 from Houston, Texas. This episode kicks off with a female Superweight bout between Gabriela Tellez and Lindsey Ellis. In the main event undefeated Deonte Brown with a 15-0 record is coming off a three year layoff to take on the tough veteran Dennis Contreras with a 24-17 record.

programme.title: UFA 429 - Red Owl BoxFest XIV part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl Boxfest XIV part 2 from Houston, Texas. Watch as Alex Dionis the hometown favorite makes his pro-debut against Andrew Flamm and in the main event Javier Martinez takes on Wayne Lawrence in a six round super-lightweight match.

programme.title: UFA 478 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Starting off in the welterweight division, Ionel Balan takes on Adrian Maxim under superfight K1 rules. In a super middleweight bout, Andei Varga and Bogdan Takacs step into the ring while Valentin Bordianu and Cristian Conea meet up for a heavyweight match. Eduard Gafencu and Florin Lambagiu take to the ring in the co-main event in the light-heavyweight division under superfight MMA rules - boxing with MMA gloves.

programme.title: UFA 459 - Real Fight Promotion 100
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Real Fight Promotion 100 from Ukraine. In this special centenial event RFP brings its viewers an exciting night of fights. First up Stanislav Bogush and Nazar Pryshliak faceoff in the flyweight division followed by Timofiy Mytkalyk versus Ruslan Danyliuk. Also Vyacheslav Vaseichuk and Andriy Dzioba square off. In the Grand Prix finals, the two remaing fighters Roman Bandrivchak and Stanislov Bogush vye for the championship.

programme.title: UFA 461 - CMH Boxing II part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents CMH Boxing II part 1 from Los Angeles California. This episode features a super lightweight bout between Adrien Boler and Benji Gomez in a match between youth and experience. Also featured, is the vacant WBC women's international light flyweight title fight as Brook Sibrian and Gloria Munguilla step into the ring for a rematch with Sibrian looking for redemption from their previous slugfest.

programme.title: UFA 462 - Shamrock FC 369
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 369 from Ameristar Hotel and Casio in Missouri. In this episode Kylen Snider takes on Ryan Richmond and Cedric Vinson faces Blake Alan. Hometown favorite Anthony Dooley "The Stormin' Morman" takes on Nick Maxwell. In the co-main event BJJ blackbelt James Regina steps into the cage with undefeated Mike Boyle looking to keep his win streak alive and in the main event undefeated Tyson Hicks takes on Andrew Horowitz in what could be Hicks' last fight in the cage,

programme.title: UFA 463 - KOK Bushido 93 Vilnius part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK Bushido 93 part 1 from Vilnius, Lithuania. First up in the featherweight division, Vladislav Jud faces Pavelas Majauskas followed by Luuk Valk versus Emilis Panceris. Valts Volkolakovs and Adomas Razma face off in the lightweight division in a semi-pro bout and in the light heavyweight division, Antioine Abou Chadid faces Kristupas Simkus.

programme.title: UFA 411 - Clan Wars 50
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 50 from Belfast. Up first a lightweight title bout with Dara O'Sullivan versus Sam "Slam" Simon, Nathan Chambers squares off against Brian Damian in the featherweight division, Lewis Byrne faces Latvian Juris Ruckanovs and Mike McBride steps into the ring with Billy Sutherland in the Bantamweight division with a title on the line. In the main event for the Superlightweight title, Peter Halpenny takes on Jamie McCaugherty.
